channels.use: Channel review rows with independent verdicts, details and video evidence

vega.use: Declarative charts, brush/selection, linked plots, plot galleries
vega.native: Vega / Vega-Lite specs; signals; embed options

plot.use: Observable Plot marks and statistical plots

flow.use: Editable architecture, Bayesian programs, AWS diagrams
flow.native: React Flow nodes/edges/flow props; ELK layout options; custom nodeTypes

mermaid.use: Text-authored flow, sequence, state, class, ER diagrams with zoom

markdown.use: Full-width GFM Markdown, tables, task lists, KaTeX math

myst.use: MyST directives, roles, equations, cross references, proofs, tabs
myst.native: source, references; no Sphinx execution or autodoc

geometry.use: GeoGebra-like interactive constructions, functions and sliders
geometry.native: JSXGraph board options, setup(board, tokens, JXG), update(board, tokens)

deck.use: Large scatter, spatial and geographic layers

sanddance.use: Animated unit-level 2D/3D layouts and dimension shelves
sanddance.native: data, insight, setup, viewer options, onSelection

recommend.use: CompassQL ranked neighboring plots and encoding choices
recommend.native: data, fields or CompassQL query, onSelect

table.use: Rich cells, images, selects, buttons, sorting, filtering and pagination
table.native: data, columns or TanStack columnDefs/table options

grid.use: Spreadsheet-like editing of larger typed datasets
grid.native: data, columns, validate, onChange, Glide props

json.use: JSON Crack graph inspection with pan and zoom

code.use: SQL/JSON editing and read-only code highlighting in common languages

sql.use: Local DuckDB queries with syntax highlighting and result tables

inputs.use: Forms, native date/select/range/file inputs and Zod validation
inputs.native: fields, values, Zod schema, onChange, onSubmit

media.use: Sliding image comparisons, zoomable images, audio and video
media.native: type: image/compare/audio/video and local/data asset sources

chat.use: Streaming conversation UI with an explicitly supplied adapter
chat.native: assistant-ui ChatModelAdapter; no built-in model or credentials

neural.use: Local dense-network training, weights, loss, tfjs-vis diagnostics

icons.use: Bundled technical, data science, architecture and official AWS icons
